newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Great Eagle IPO to raise $259 mln - paper.
newsitem.headline: HK Great Eagle IPO to raise $259 mln - paper.

text.p: Hong Kong property group Great Eagle Holdings Ltd would raise at least HK$2 billion (US$259 million) from the expected spinoff of its office property arm, a newspaper said on Saturday.
Cash from from the issue would fund the group's 35 percent stake in the Mong Kok urban renewal project, the Hong Kong Standard quoted market sources as saying.

The recent boom in Hong Kong's office property market meant the firm's initial public offering would proceed in a few months, the sources said. The spinoff had been postponed since October 1996 because the company's shares were trading at a sharp discount to the market last year.
Great Eagle's shares have since surged 66 percent from their 1996 low of HK$20.20 to close at 33.60 on Friday.
Great Eagle deputy chairman K.S. Lo said last August the new company would seek a listing on the Hong Kong stock exchange but would remain a subsidiary of Great Eagle after the listing.
The Mong Kok joint venture urban renewal project will redevelop land in the heart of Hong Kong's Kowloon Peninsula in conjunction with the government's Land Development Corp.
